Fingerprint.description:
Identifies a source file without hashing all of it.

Computed by the engine (size, modification time and a BLAKE3 hash of the
first and last megabytes); `blurrd-core` only defines the type.

blake3_head_tail.description: Hex BLAKE3 hash of the head and tail of the file.

mtime.description: Modification time in seconds since the Unix epoch.

FrameRange.description: An inclusive range of presentation frame indices, written as `[f0, f1]`.

Leak.description: One leak, merged over the frames on which it was readable.

dedup.description:

RectI.description:
An axis-aligned, half-open rectangle in source pixels.

The rectangle covers the pixels with `x0 <= x < x1` and `y0 <= y < y1`,
so `x1 - x0` is its width. A `RectI` is never empty: [`RectI::new`] and
deserialisation reject rectangles without area. In JSON it is written as
`[x0, y0, x1, y1]`.

Region.description:
A screen region that can contain player names.

The detector regions are the gameplay HUD parts that blurrd finds by
itself. [`Region::Manual`] marks boxes the user drew; they are always
applied, whichever regions are enabled. World-space name tags above
players' heads are out of scope and have no region.

items.description: Number of items (names over their lifetime) checked.

positive_control.description: Fraction of items whose name OCR read on the clean source, 0.0 to 1.0.

unverifiable_items.description:
